explanation: The source at erdosproblems.com/1017 says 'Estimate f(n,k) for k>n²/4'. Discrepancy: the Lean statement only needs f n k≤answer n k, so taking answer n k:=f n k, or n²/4-type bounds from the Erdős-Goodman-Pósa theorem quoted on the page, proves it. It therefore does not capture any sharpening, which the page says is what Erdős was asking about.
